hero.title: YOUR STORE. YOUR RULES.
hero.description: Explore our catalog and discover products selected for you.

items.title: Your store
items.text: Manage products from your own dashboard

items.question: Can I place an order?
items.answer: Available shipping and payment methods are shown at checkout.

items.question: Can I change this content?
items.answer: Yes. Hero content, navigation, feature blocks, FAQ, modal content, footer sections, brand assets and theme colors are configurable from the admin panel.

items.question: How are orders processed?
items.answer: Customers choose an active shipping and payment method during checkout. Store staff can then manage the order from the administration panel.

footer.callback_text: Contact us and we will help you choose the right product.

platform.title: Velmora — your store, your server.
platform.description: Velmora is a self-hosted e-commerce platform. This shop runs on an independent installation controlled by its owner.
platform.support_text: Velmora is an independent open-source project. Explore the project on GitHub, share feedback, and support its continued development.

about.title: Discover our store
about.lead: Browse our selection, compare product specifications and find the right option for your needs. Our team can help with product questions and orders.

cards.title: Product information
cards.text: Find specifications, photos and practical details on every product page.

cards.title: Personal assistance
cards.text: Need help choosing? Contact us and we will answer your questions.

about.callout_text: Get in touch before placing your order if you need more information.

shipping.title: Ordering and delivery
shipping.lead: Place your order online and choose from the available delivery and payment options at checkout. We will keep you informed about your order.

steps.title: Select your item
steps.text: Choose your product and review its details before ordering.

steps.title: Confirm your details
steps.text: Enter contact information so we can confirm and process your order.

steps.title: Choose payment
steps.text: Select one of the payment options available during checkout.

steps.title: Order processing
steps.text: We prepare your order and share delivery details when they are available.

contacts.title: Order and product support
contacts.lead: Contact the store for product, order, setup, and warranty questions.

cards.title: Choose the right product
cards.text: Ask questions before ordering if you are unsure which product fits your needs.

cards.title: Order support

cards.title: Warranty questions
cards.text: Describe the issue and attach photos or video when useful.

contacts.callout_title: What to include in your message
contacts.callout_text: Include the product name, order number if available, and a short description of your question.
